reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the collector and extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the rare-disease reanalysis use-case batch for use-case-unresolved-rare-disease-reanalysis: 904 records (711 results, 84 evaluations, 84 configurations, 14 claims of which 9 are relevance judgements, 4 sources, 3 methods, 2 protocols, 2 datasets). All four source artifacts were re-downloaded and matched their recorded SHA-256. All 711 results were re-read from the pinned cells with a separate parser (the extractor's script was not run) and match in printed and numeric value, locator, metric, qualifier, unit, direction, evaluation, configuration, protocol and dataset; recall, precision, F1 and F2 recompute from the TP, FN and FP cells on all 81 Vestito et al. rows. The 9 proxy judgements were checked against the use case's question, inputs, output and exclusions and are source_checked with reviewed_evaluations; pins are not set. Corrections change no number and are listed in docs/reviews/use-cases/unresolved-rare-disease-reanalysis-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review, not reproduction of any tool and not clinical validation.
Figures were not read (Demidov et al. Fig. 3, Talos Extended Data Fig. 1).
The Talos source records pin the publisher page; the stored Talos values were compared with the PMC copy (PMC13472938), whose hash is recorded in the judgement reviews, not with the pinned bytes.
Europe PMC supplementaryFiles requests returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-09; both supplementary PDFs were fetched from the publisher and matched the pinned hashes.
Pins for the 9 judgements are not set; the use case's assessed_by links and gap changes are approved in the dated review but not applied here.
npm run build was not run (disk limit, by instruction). npm test and npm run typecheck passed, and a scratch-store dry run of addBatch, loadRecords and deriveUseCaseInputs succeeded.
Rerunning extract/extract_rare_reanalysis.py would restore the collector's wording for the corrected configuration versions and parameters and the corrected claim.

errors.message: Version recorded as unreported; the article's Code availability prints ClinCNV 1.16.6, CoNIFER 0.2.2 and ExomeDepth 1.1.15.
Rerun rule for CoNIFER batches was simplified to the median condition only; the Methods also require every experiment to have fewer than 30 calls.

ClinCNV origin reason strengthened: ref. 47 is the first author's thesis and he is listed under Software. Per-caller counts overlap (one row per caller per CNV, Supplementary Table 2), so their sum counts calls, not distinct CNVs; added to limitations.
Wording misstated the ExomeDepth discard (one of the ten, not one of the 40); a case-level gene name was removed.
Parameters cited Methods 'Reanalysis optimisation' for default settings, which that section does not state; now says other settings are not stated for these runs.

Limitations rewritten: recall on known diagnoses stated plainly as not new diagnostic yield; threshold tuning narrowed to the 0.2/0.8 row; 194 against 190 narrowed to the Extended Data Fig. 1 legend. Six Talos headline metrics changed from recall to candidates-per-case.
Archived article XML contained Table 2, one row per pathogenic CNV with pseudonymised individual and family identifiers. Removed from the batch; URL and SHA-256 remain on the source record.
Added skos:exactMatch STATO_0000597 ('number of true negative'), checked in OLS4 on 2026-10-09.
